text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
—Still, what a coincidence! To think we'd 
both have work meetings at the Academy on 
the very same day.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. ...Light Hello-san, do you 
have any plans after this?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Since we have this opportunity, would you 
care to join me for a meal? There's a 
restaurant I've been wanting to introduce 
you to.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
A recommendation from Tsurugi-san...! It's 
guaranteed to be delicious, isn't it! I'd 
love to go with you!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much. That place is 
very particular about its sake and wine. 
You like wine, correct?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...Ah, but lately, I've been getting 
interested in sake, too—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You're quite fond of sake, aren't you, 
Tsurugi-san? If it's alright with you, 
could you teach me a few things about it 
sometime?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Why, of course, with pleasure. We also 
have small tasting sets available, so I am 
certain you will find something to your 
liking.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
! ...By the way, what's your personal 
recommendation at that place, Ms. Tsurugi?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the "salted beef liver." Thanks to its 
simple seasoning, it has the versatility 
to pair beautifully with both wine and 
sake. Truly exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ehh...! That sounds totally delicious...! 
I won't be able to decide whether to pair 
it with wine or sake...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Shall we try both? Take your time, 
and make sure to drink some water in 
between.
